Meta.title: Badulake · Meet-ups to swap things, no money involved
Meta.description: Meet-ups to swap clothes and things you no longer use. No money involved. Join the waiting list.

Home.tagline: Meet-ups to swap clothes and things you no longer use. No money involved.
Home.coming: Badulake is coming in early 2027. Sign up and we'll let you know.
Home.comingSoon: Badulake is coming in early 2027. You'll be able to join the waiting list very soon.
Home.point1: Get together, 5 to 10 people, at a venue near you.
Home.point2: Bring what you no longer use and take home what you like.
Home.point3: Clear out your wardrobe and have fun.

Account.interestIntro: They don't exist today and cost nothing. We just want to know if you'd be interested, to help us decide what to do next.

Account.forgotIntro: Enter your account's email address and, if it exists, we'll send you a link to choose a new password.

Account.deleteIntro: If you delete your account, it is really deleted, straight away:
Account.deleteItem1: Your profile, your badulake sign-ups, your waiting lists and your “I'm interested” choices.
Account.deleteItem2: The badulakes you organise and their addresses. If any of them have people signed up, they are cancelled first and those people are notified; the rest are deleted.
Account.deleteItem3: Your reports remain, but without any data that identifies you.

Badulake.notYetTitle: You can't organise a badulake yet
Badulake.notYetBody: So that people know the rules well, only those who have already been to a badulake can organise one. Once you've been to a badulake (signed up and not marked “Didn't turn up” by the organiser), you'll be able to organise your own. In the meantime, have a look at the upcoming badulakes and sign up for one.

WhatIs.title: What is a badulake?
WhatIs.intro: A badulake is an in-person meet-up of 5 to 10 people to swap clothes and things you no longer use. Nobody pays or charges anything.
WhatIs.step1: Create your account. It's free and only for people aged 18 or over.
WhatIs.step2: Find a badulake and sign up. Once you sign up, you'll see the exact address.
WhatIs.step3: Bring along the things you no longer use.
WhatIs.step4: Swap: take home whatever you like.
WhatIs.organize: Would you rather organise one yourself? Create a badulake and publish it.

Install.title: Install it on your phone
Install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up), at the bottom or top of Safari.
Install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
Install.iosStep3: Tap “Add”. Badulake will appear like any other app.
